topic: Adoption barriers for heat pumps in cold-climate retrofits

entries.question: Do cold-climate (ccASHP) heat pumps maintain rated heating capacity below -15 C?
entries.claim: Modern cold-climate air-source heat pumps retain a usable, derated heating capacity down to roughly -15 to -25 C, though capacity and COP fall as temperature drops.

sources.title: Independent field performance study of ccASHPs in northern climates

entries.question: What is the typical installed cost premium of a heat pump retrofit vs a gas furnace replacement?
entries.claim: Installed-cost premiums vary widely by region and home, commonly reported in the low-to-mid thousands of dollars before incentives.
